evals.prompt: Make a website for my bakery: menu, location and hours, contact, and a way to take cake orders.
evals.expected_output: A conversion-led outline plus a static-first build with forms handled by a service.
expectations: Starts from the conversion action (cake orders) before writing code
Produces a section outline with one message per section, not code first
Recommends a static-first stack, not a Vite SPA or a database-backed app
Handles the order form via an endpoint service, never mailto-only
Gives one stack recommendation rather than a menu

evals.prompt: Check this landing page before launch.
evals.expected_output: Runs site-check, FAILs broken links, WARNs missing SEO tags with exact fixes.
expectations: Runs scripts/site-check.sh and reports its FAIL line
Flags the broken pricing and contact links with the fix
Flags missing meta description, OG tags, and canonical with exact markup
Flags the missing sitemap.xml and robots.txt
Flags the form without an endpoint

evals.prompt: Astro or Next.js for our marketing site? We already have a Next.js product app.
evals.expected_output: Recommends Next.js static export with the shared-code reason, done in one line for Astro.
expectations: Recommends static export inside the existing Next.js app with the reason
States Astro as the rejected alternative in one line (no existing Astro codebase)
Warns against mixing server features into the static pages
Gives one recommendation rather than a menu

evals.prompt: We need a blog our non-technical team can publish to weekly.
evals.expected_output: A CMS decision driven by editor pain with Markdown-first as the rejected default.
expectations: Recommends a headless CMS or hosted MDX platform tied to the weekly non-technical publishing need
States Markdown-in-git as the rejected default with the editor-pain reason
Refuses to build a custom CMS with the never-ending-project reason
Mentions sitemap regeneration on content change

evals.prompt: Our shared links show a gray box with no image. Fix our link previews.
evals.expected_output: OG tag diagnosis with exact markup and validator verification.
expectations: Identifies missing og:title/og:image as the cause
Requires absolute URLs and the 1200x630 image size
Provides the exact meta markup
Verifies with a card validator, not by re-sharing blindly

evals.prompt: Build a dashboard where our clients log in to see their orders.
evals.expected_output: Redirects to web-app-development with the one-line boundary reason.
expectations: Refuses to build it as a marketing site
Names logins plus per-user data as the web-app trigger in one line
Hands off to web-app-development explicitly
Does not scaffold auth, a database, or an admin panel

evals.prompt: Plan the information architecture for a freelancer portfolio: work, services, about, contact.
evals.expected_output: A sequenced outline led by proof-before-ask with copy status tracking.
expectations: Follows the landing-outline template order (proof before the ask)
Puts selected work and testimonials ahead of the contact CTA
Marks unapproved copy as TODO with an owner rather than shipping lorem ipsum
Includes per-page title and description in the plan

evals.prompt: Our staging site is ranking on Google instead of production. What happened?
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the robots/sitemap mix-up with the launch checklist fix.
expectations: Identifies staging robots/sitemap or canonicals pointing at staging
Requires Disallow: / on staging and allow on production
Requires canonicals to be absolute production URLs
Gives the pre-launch verification steps, not just the fix
